reason: Accepted c07 documents appearance only as an unspecified ordinary person or animal, feeding some livestock and persecuting others. It supplies no distinctive anatomy, attributes or visibly supernatural active manifestation. A threatening barn scene would depict an ordinary person or animal; adding monstrous anatomy or magical effects to distinguish the spirit would invent unsupported facts. Deferred under GAMBAR6.5 and source-faithful Sangar constraints.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: Do not invent distinctive anatomy, iconographic attributes, giant size or magical visual effects absent from accepted claims.
